## framework/detail/Application.inl

Assimp 전용 런타임 경로를 AssetLoader 생성 인자에서 제거한다. GLFW 런타임 경로는 보존한다.

적용 경로:

- `framework/detail/Application.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_15/framework/detail/Application.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_16/framework/detail/Application.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_17/framework/detail/Application.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_18/framework/detail/Application.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_19/framework/detail/Application.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_20/framework/detail/Application.inl`
- `standard/framework/detail/Application.inl`

### before

```text
#pragma once
#include <algorithm>
#include <iostream>
#include <utility>
namespace graphics::detail {
inline bool& applicationActive() { static bool active=false;return active; }
}
namespace graphics {

inline Application::~Application() {
    shutdown();
}

inline void Application::setInitHandler(std::function<bool(Application&)> handler) {
    initHandler_ = std::move(handler);
}

inline void Application::setUpdateHandler(std::function<void(Application&, float)> handler) {
    updateHandler_ = std::move(handler);
}

inline void Application::setKeyHandler(std::function<void(Application&, int, int)> handler) {
    keyHandler_ = std::move(handler);
}

inline void Application::setModifiedKeyHandler(
    std::function<void(Application&, int, int, int)> handler) {
    modifiedKeyHandler_ = std::move(handler);
}

inline void Application::setFocusHandler(std::function<void(Application&, bool)> handler) {
    focusHandler_ = std::move(handler);
}

inline void Application::setRenderHandler(std::function<bool(Application&)> handler) {
    renderHandler_ = std::move(handler);
}

inline bool Application::initialize(const ApplicationConfig& config) {
    const auto root=detail::relativePathInside(detail::executableDirectory(),config.projectRoot);
    const auto runtime=detail::relativePathInside(root,config.runtimeDirectory);
    detail::glfw().load(runtime);
    if (config.width <= 0 || config.height <= 0 || !detail::glfw().Init()) {
        return false;
    }
    glfwInitialized_ = true;
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR, 3);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MINOR, 3);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_OPENGL_PROFILE, GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_DOUBLEBUFFER, GLFW_TRUE);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_DEPTH_BITS, 24);
    window_ = detail::glfw().createWindow(config.width, config.height,
                              config.title.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr);
    if (window_ == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }
    detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);
    detail::glfw().SwapInterval(config.verticalSync ? 1 : 0);
    const auto vertexPath=config.shaderDirectory.empty()?std::filesystem::path{}:detail::relativePathInside(root,config.shaderDirectory)/"VertexShader.glsl";
    const auto fragmentPath=config.shaderDirectory.empty()?std::filesystem::path{}:detail::relativePathInside(root,config.shaderDirectory)/"FragmentShader.glsl";
    if(!renderer_.initialize(vertexPath,fragmentPath)) return false;
    assets_.emplace(root,config.features,runtime);
    renderOptions_.textures=config.features.textures;

    detail::glfw().SetInputMode(window_, GLFW_LOCK_KEY_MODS, GLFW_TRUE);
    detail::glfw().SetWindowUserPointer(window_, this);
    detail::glfw().SetKeyCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window, int key, int, int action, int mods) {
        auto& app=*static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));
        app.dispatch([&] {
            if(app.modifiedKeyHandler_)app.modifiedKeyHandler_(app,key,action,mods);
            else if(app.keyHandler_)app.keyHandler_(app,key,action);
        });
    });
    detail::glfw().SetWindowFocusCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window,int focused) {
        auto& app=*static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));
        app.dispatch([&]{if(app.focusHandler_)app.focusHandler_(app,focused==GLFW_TRUE);});
    });
    detail::glfw().SetMouseButtonCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window,int button,int action,int mods) {
        auto& app=*static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));
        app.dispatch([&] {
            if(!app.mouseHandler_)return;
            MouseEvent event;event.button=button;event.action=action;event.mods=mods;
            detail::glfw().GetCursorPos(window,&event.windowX,&event.windowY);
            int ww=0,wh=0,fw=0,fh=0;
            detail::glfw().GetWindowSize(window,&ww,&wh);detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window,&fw,&fh);
            if(ww<=0||wh<=0||fw<=0||fh<=0)return;
            event.framebufferX=event.windowX*fw/ww;event.framebufferY=event.windowY*fh/wh;
            app.mouseHandler_(app,event);
        });
    });
    detail::glfw().SetCursorPosCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window,double x,double y) {
        auto& app=*static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));
        app.dispatch([&]{if(app.cursorHandler_)app.cursorHandler_(app,x,y);});
    });
    return true;
}

inline void Application::shutdown() {
    assets_.reset();
    if (window_ != nullptr) {
        detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);
        renderer_.destroy();
        detail::glfw().SetWindowUserPointer(window_, nullptr);
        detail::glfw().DestroyWindow(window_);
        window_ = nullptr;
    }
    if (glfwInitialized_) {
        detail::glfw().Terminate();
        glfwInitialized_ = false;
    }
}

inline void Application::requestClose() {
    if (window_ != nullptr) {
        detail::glfw().SetWindowShouldClose(window_, GLFW_TRUE);
    }
}

inline bool Application::renderScene() {
    if (window_ == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }
    detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);
    int width = 0;
    int height = 0;
    detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window_, &width, &height);
    return renderer_.render(scene_, camera_, width, height, renderOptions_);
}

inline int Application::run(const ApplicationConfig& config) {
    if (running_) {
        return -1; // 콜백에서 run()을 재귀 호출하지 않는다.
    }
    if(detail::applicationActive()) return -1;
    // /utf-8 encodes narrow strings; the Windows console must decode them as UTF-8.
    SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8);
    detail::applicationActive()=true;
    callbackError_=nullptr;
    running_ = true;
    int exitCode = 0;
    try {
        if (!initialize(config)) {
            std::cerr << "Application initialization failed.\n";
            exitCode = -1;
        } else if (initHandler_ && !initHandler_(*this)) {
            std::cerr << "User scene initialization failed.\n";
            exitCode = -1;
        } else {
            double previousTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
            while (!detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                detail::glfw().PollEvents();
                if(callbackError_)std::rethrow_exception(callbackError_);
                if (detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                    break;
                }
                int width = 0;
                int height = 0;
                detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window_, &width, &height);
                if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
                    detail::glfw().WaitEvents();
                    if(callbackError_)std::rethrow_exception(callbackError_);
                    previousTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
                    continue;
                }
                const double currentTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
                const float deltaTime = static_cast<float>(
                    std::clamp(currentTime - previousTime, 0.0, 0.05));
                previousTime = currentTime;
                if (updateHandler_) {
                    updateHandler_(*this, deltaTime);
                }
                if (detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                    break;
                }
                if (!scene_.updateMotions(deltaTime)) {
                    std::cerr << "Motion update failed.\n";
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }
                detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);
                const bool rendered = renderHandler_
                    ? renderHandler_(*this) : renderScene();
                if (!rendered) {
                    std::cerr << "Rendering failed.\n";
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }
                detail::glfw().SwapBuffers(window_);
            }
        }
    } catch (...) {
        shutdown();
        running_ = false;
        detail::applicationActive()=false;
        throw; // 사용자 예외를 숨기지 않고 컨텍스트 자원부터 정리한다.
    }
    shutdown();
    running_ = false;
    detail::applicationActive()=false;
```

```text
inline bool Application::initialize(const ApplicationConfig& config) {
    const auto root=detail::relativePathInside(detail::executableDirectory(),config.projectRoot);
    const auto runtime=detail::relativePathInside(root,config.runtimeDirectory);
    detail::glfw().load(runtime);
    if (config.width <= 0 || config.height <= 0 || !detail::glfw().Init()) {
        return false;
    }
    glfwInitialized_ = true;
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MAJOR, 3);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_CONTEXT_VERSION_MINOR, 3);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_OPENGL_PROFILE, GLFW_OPENGL_CORE_PROFILE);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_DOUBLEBUFFER, GLFW_TRUE);
    detail::glfw().WindowHint(GLFW_DEPTH_BITS, 24);
    window_ = detail::glfw().createWindow(config.width, config.height,
                              config.title.c_str(), nullptr, nullptr);
    if (window_ == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }
    detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);
    detail::glfw().SwapInterval(config.verticalSync ? 1 : 0);
    const auto vertexPath=config.shaderDirectory.empty()?std::filesystem::path{}:detail::relativePathInside(root,config.shaderDirectory)/"VertexShader.glsl";
    const auto fragmentPath=config.shaderDirectory.empty()?std::filesystem::path{}:detail::relativePathInside(root,config.shaderDirectory)/"FragmentShader.glsl";
    if(!renderer_.initialize(vertexPath,fragmentPath)) return false;
    assets_.emplace(root,config.features);
    renderOptions_.textures=config.features.textures;

    detail::glfw().SetInputMode(window_, GLFW_LOCK_KEY_MODS, GLFW_TRUE);
    detail::glfw().SetWindowUserPointer(window_, this);
    detail::glfw().SetKeyCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window, int key, int, int action, int mods) {
        auto& app=*static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));
        app.dispatch([&] {
            if(app.modifiedKeyHandler_)app.modifiedKeyHandler_(app,key,action,mods);
            else if(app.keyHandler_)app.keyHandler_(app,key,action);
        });
    });
    detail::glfw().SetWindowFocusCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window,int focused) {
        auto& app=*static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));
        app.dispatch([&]{if(app.focusHandler_)app.focusHandler_(app,focused==GLFW_TRUE);});
    });
    detail::glfw().SetMouseButtonCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window,int button,int action,int mods) {
        auto& app=*static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));
        app.dispatch([&] {
            if(!app.mouseHandler_)return;
            MouseEvent event;event.button=button;event.action=action;event.mods=mods;
            detail::glfw().GetCursorPos(window,&event.windowX,&event.windowY);
            int ww=0,wh=0,fw=0,fh=0;
            detail::glfw().GetWindowSize(window,&ww,&wh);detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window,&fw,&fh);
            if(ww<=0||wh<=0||fw<=0||fh<=0)return;
            event.framebufferX=event.windowX*fw/ww;event.framebufferY=event.windowY*fh/wh;
            app.mouseHandler_(app,event);
        });
    });
    detail::glfw().SetCursorPosCallback(window_, [](GLFWwindow* window,double x,double y) {
        auto& app=*static_cast<Application*>(detail::glfw().GetWindowUserPointer(window));
        app.dispatch([&]{if(app.cursorHandler_)app.cursorHandler_(app,x,y);});
    });
    return true;
}

inline void Application::shutdown() {
    assets_.reset();
    if (window_ != nullptr) {
        detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);
        renderer_.destroy();
        detail::glfw().SetWindowUserPointer(window_, nullptr);
        detail::glfw().DestroyWindow(window_);
        window_ = nullptr;
    }
    if (glfwInitialized_) {
        detail::glfw().Terminate();
        glfwInitialized_ = false;
    }
}

inline void Application::requestClose() {
    if (window_ != nullptr) {
        detail::glfw().SetWindowShouldClose(window_, GLFW_TRUE);
    }
}

inline bool Application::renderScene() {
    if (window_ == nullptr) {
        return false;
    }
    detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);
    int width = 0;
    int height = 0;
    detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window_, &width, &height);
    return renderer_.render(scene_, camera_, width, height, renderOptions_);
}

inline int Application::run(const ApplicationConfig& config) {
    if (running_) {
        return -1; // 콜백에서 run()을 재귀 호출하지 않는다.
    }
    if(detail::applicationActive()) return -1;
    // /utf-8 encodes narrow strings; the Windows console must decode them as UTF-8.
    SetConsoleOutputCP(CP_UTF8);
    detail::applicationActive()=true;
    callbackError_=nullptr;
    running_ = true;
    int exitCode = 0;
    try {
        if (!initialize(config)) {
            std::cerr << "Application initialization failed.\n";
            exitCode = -1;
        } else if (initHandler_ && !initHandler_(*this)) {
            std::cerr << "User scene initialization failed.\n";
            exitCode = -1;
        } else {
            double previousTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
            while (!detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                detail::glfw().PollEvents();
                if(callbackError_)std::rethrow_exception(callbackError_);
                if (detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                    break;
                }
                int width = 0;
                int height = 0;
                detail::glfw().GetFramebufferSize(window_, &width, &height);
                if (width <= 0 || height <= 0) {
                    detail::glfw().WaitEvents();
                    if(callbackError_)std::rethrow_exception(callbackError_);
                    previousTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
                    continue;
                }
                const double currentTime = detail::glfw().GetTime();
                const float deltaTime = static_cast<float>(
                    std::clamp(currentTime - previousTime, 0.0, 0.05));
                previousTime = currentTime;
                if (updateHandler_) {
                    updateHandler_(*this, deltaTime);
                }
                if (detail::glfw().WindowShouldClose(window_)) {
                    break;
                }
                if (!scene_.updateMotions(deltaTime)) {
                    std::cerr << "Motion update failed.\n";
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }
                detail::glfw().MakeContextCurrent(window_);
                const bool rendered = renderHandler_
                    ? renderHandler_(*this) : renderScene();
                if (!rendered) {
                    std::cerr << "Rendering failed.\n";
                    exitCode = -1;
                    break;
                }
                detail::glfw().SwapBuffers(window_);
            }
        }
    } catch (...) {
        shutdown();
        running_ = false;
        detail::applicationActive()=false;
        throw; // 사용자 예외를 숨기지 않고 컨텍스트 자원부터 정리한다.
    }
    shutdown();
    running_ = false;
    detail::applicationActive()=false;
    return exitCode;
}
```

```text
#pragma once
#include "../dependencies/assimp/include/assimp/cimport.h"

#include <functional>
namespace graphics {
namespace detail {
struct AssimpApi {
    Module module;
    bool ready = false;
    decltype(&::aiImportFile) importFile = nullptr;
    decltype(&::aiReleaseImport) releaseImport = nullptr;
    decltype(&::aiGetErrorString) getError = nullptr;
    decltype(&::aiGetMaterialColor) getColor = nullptr;
    decltype(&::aiGetMaterialTexture) getTexture = nullptr;
    void load(const std::filesystem::path& root) {
        if(ready) return;
        module.open((root.empty()?frameworkDirectory():std::filesystem::absolute(root))
                    / "dependencies/assimp/bin/assimp-vc145-mt.dll");
        importFile=module.symbol<decltype(importFile)>("aiImportFile");
        releaseImport=module.symbol<decltype(releaseImport)>("aiReleaseImport");
        getError=module.symbol<decltype(getError)>("aiGetErrorString");
        getColor=module.symbol<decltype(getColor)>("aiGetMaterialColor");
        getTexture=module.symbol<decltype(getTexture)>("aiGetMaterialTexture");
        ready=true;
    }
};
inline AssimpApi& assimp() { static AssimpApi api; return api; }
inline glm::mat4 assimpMatrix(const aiMatrix4x4& a) {
    return glm::mat4(a.a1,a.b1,a.c1,a.d1, a.a2,a.b2,a.c2,a.d2,
                     a.a3,a.b3,a.c3,a.d3, a.a4,a.b4,a.c4,a.d4);
}
}
inline ModelResult AssetLoader::loadModel(const std::filesystem::path& relative,const LoadOptions& options) const {
        ModelResult result;
        if(!features_.models) {result.error="Assimp model mode is disabled.";return result;}
        if(!features_.textures&&!options.texturePath.empty()) {result.error="Texture mode is disabled.";return result;}
        try {
            const auto path=resolve(relative);
            auto& api=detail::assimp(); api.load(runtimeRoot_);
            const aiScene* scene=api.importFile(path.u8string().c_str(),aiProcess_Triangulate
                |aiProcess_JoinIdenticalVertices|aiProcess_GenSmoothNormals|aiProcess_ValidateDataStructure);
            if(!scene) throw std::runtime_error(api.getError());
            struct Release { detail::AssimpApi& api; const aiScene* scene; ~Release(){api.releaseImport(scene);} } release{api,scene};
            if(!scene->mRootNode) throw std::runtime_error("Model has no root node.");
            Model model; model.shape=GLShape::Imported; model.name=relative.u8string();
            std::map<unsigned int,Material> materials;
            std::map<unsigned int,unsigned int> uvChannels;
            for(unsigned int i=0;i<scene->mNumMaterials;++i) {
                Material material; aiColor4D color;
                if(api.getColor(scene->mMaterials[i],AI_MATKEY_BASE_COLOR,&color)==AI_SUCCESS
                    ||api.getColor(scene->mMaterials[i],AI_MATKEY_COLOR_DIFFUSE,&color)==AI_SUCCESS)
                    material.color={color.r,color.g,color.b};
                unsigned int uvChannel=0;
                if(features_.textures) {
                    if(!options.texturePath.empty()) material.texture=texture(options.texturePath,options.flipTextureRows);
                    else {
                        aiString texturePath;
                        aiReturn found=api.getTexture(scene->mMaterials[i],aiTextureType_BASE_COLOR,0,&texturePath,nullptr,&uvChannel,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr);
                        if(found!=AI_SUCCESS) found=api.getTexture(scene->mMaterials[i],aiTextureType_DIFFUSE,0,&texturePath,nullptr,&uvChannel,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr,nullptr);
                        if(found==AI_SUCCESS) {
                            const aiTexture* embedded=scene->GetEmbeddedTexture(texturePath.C_Str());
                            if(embedded) {
                                TextureImage image;
                                if(embedded->mHeight==0) {
                                    const auto* bytes=reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t*>(embedded->pcData);
                                    std::vector<std::uint8_t> data(bytes,bytes+embedded->mWidth);
                                    image=detail::decodeImage({},&data,options.flipTextureRows);
                                } else {
                                    image.width=embedded->mWidth;image.height=embedded->mHeight;
                                    if(!image.width||!image.height||image.width>16384||image.height>16384)
                                        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid embedded texture size.");
                                    image.rgba.resize(std::size_t(image.width)*image.height*4);
                                    for(unsigned int y=0;y<image.height;++y) for(unsigned int x=0;x<image.width;++x) {
                                        const auto& pixel=embedded->pcData[std::size_t(y)*image.width+x];
                                        const auto dest=(std::size_t(options.flipTextureRows?image.height-1-y:y)*image.width+x)*4;
                                        image.rgba[dest]=pixel.r;image.rgba[dest+1]=pixel.g;image.rgba[dest+2]=pixel.b;image.rgba[dest+3]=pixel.a;
                                    }
                                }
                                material.texture=std::make_shared<const TextureImage>(std::move(image));
                            } else material.texture=texture(relative.parent_path()/std::filesystem::u8path(texturePath.C_Str()),options.flipTextureRows);
                        }
                    }
                    material.useTexture=bool(material.texture);
                }
                materials[i]=material;uvChannels[i]=uvChannel;
            }
            std::function<void(const aiNode*,const glm::mat4&)> visit;
            visit=[&](const aiNode* node,const glm::mat4& parent) {
                const auto matrix=parent*detail::assimpMatrix(node->mTransformation);
                const auto linear=glm::mat3(matrix);const auto determinant=glm::determinant(linear);
                const bool invertible=std::isfinite(determinant)&&std::abs(determinant)>1e-12f;
                const auto normalMatrix=invertible?glm::transpose(glm::inverse(linear)):glm::mat3(1);
                for(unsigned int n=0;n<node->mNumMeshes;++n) {
                    if(node->mMeshes[n]>=scene->mNumMeshes) throw std::runtime_error("Invalid node mesh index.");
                    const auto* source=scene->mMeshes[node->mMeshes[n]];
                    if(!source->HasPositions()) continue;
                    Mesh mesh; mesh.name=node->mName.C_Str();mesh.material=materials[source->mMaterialIndex];
                    const auto uvChannel=uvChannels[source->mMaterialIndex];
                    for(unsigned int v=0;v<source->mNumVertices;++v) {
                        const auto p=source->mVertices[v];mesh.localVertices.push_back(glm::vec3(matrix*glm::vec4(p.x,p.y,p.z,1)));
                        if(source->HasNormals()&&invertible) {
                            const auto normal=source->mNormals[v];const auto transformed=normalMatrix*glm::vec3(normal.x,normal.y,normal.z);
                            mesh.vertexNormals.push_back(glm::length(transformed)>1e-12f?glm::normalize(transformed):glm::vec3(0));
                        }
                        if(features_.textures&&source->HasTextureCoords(uvChannel)) {
                            const auto uv=source->mTextureCoords[uvChannel][v];mesh.texcoords.push_back({uv.x,uv.y});
                        }
                        if(source->HasVertexColors(0)) {const auto c=source->mColors[0][v];mesh.vertexColors.push_back({c.r,c.g,c.b});}
                    }
                    for(unsigned int f=0;f<source->mNumFaces;++f) {
                        const auto& face=source->mFaces[f];if(face.mNumIndices!=3) continue;
                        mesh.triangleIndices.insert(mesh.triangleIndices.end(),{face.mIndices[0],
                            face.mIndices[determinant<0?2:1],face.mIndices[determinant<0?1:2]});
                    }
                    if(mesh.triangleIndices.empty()) continue;
                    if(mesh.vertexNormals.empty()) recalculateNormals(mesh);
                    if(mesh.material.useTexture&&mesh.texcoords.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("Textured mesh is missing the requested UV channel.");
                    model.faces.push_back(std::move(mesh));
                }
                for(unsigned int i=0;i<node->mNumChildren;++i) visit(node->mChildren[i],matrix);
            };
            visit(scene->mRootNode,glm::mat4(1));
            return detail::finishLoad(std::move(model),options);
        } catch(const std::exception& e) {result.error=e.what();return result;}
    }
} // namespace graphics
```

```text
#pragma once
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <locale>
#include <iterator>

namespace graphics::detail {
struct ObjParseError : std::runtime_error { using std::runtime_error::runtime_error; };
struct ObjCorner {
    long long position=0, uv=0, normal=0;
    bool operator==(const ObjCorner& b) const {
        return position==b.position && uv==b.uv && normal==b.normal;
    }
};
struct ObjFace {
    std::vector<ObjCorner> corners;
    std::size_t positions=0, uvs=0, normals=0, line=0, batch=0;
    std::string name;
};
inline void objWarning(std::vector<std::string>& warnings,const std::string& message) {
    if(std::find(warnings.begin(),warnings.end(),message)==warnings.end()) warnings.push_back(message);
}
inline long long objInteger(const std::string& text) {
    const auto start=(!text.empty() && (text[0]=='-' || text[0]=='+'))?1u:0u;
    if(start==text.size() || text.find_first_not_of("0123456789",start)!=std::string::npos)
        throw ObjParseError("Invalid OBJ index: "+text);
    try {
        const auto value=std::stoll(text);
        if(value==0) throw ObjParseError("OBJ indices start at 1; zero is invalid.");
        return value;
    } catch(const std::out_of_range&) { throw ObjParseError("OBJ index is too large."); }
}
inline ObjCorner objCorner(const std::string& text) {
    ObjCorner result;
    const auto a=text.find('/'), b=a==std::string::npos?a:text.find('/',a+1);
    if(b!=std::string::npos && text.find('/',b+1)!=std::string::npos)
        throw ObjParseError("Too many fields in OBJ corner: "+text);
    result.position=objInteger(text.substr(0,a));
    if(a!=std::string::npos) {
        const auto part=text.substr(a+1,b==std::string::npos?b:b-a-1);
        if(!part.empty()) result.uv=objInteger(part);
        else if(b==std::string::npos) throw ObjParseError("Missing UV after '/'.");
    }
    if(b!=std::string::npos) {
        if(b+1==text.size()) throw ObjParseError("Missing normal after '//'.");
        result.normal=objInteger(text.substr(b+1));
    }
    return result;
}
inline std::size_t objResolve(long long value,std::size_t atFace,std::size_t total,bool compatible) {
    // Negative references use counts at the face, even during the second pass.
    if(value<0) {
        if(value < -static_cast<long long>(atFace)) throw ObjParseError("Negative OBJ index is out of range.");
        return std::size_t(static_cast<long long>(atFace)+value);
    }
    if(static_cast<unsigned long long>(value)>(compatible?total:atFace))
        throw ObjParseError("Positive OBJ index is out of range or references a later record.");
    return std::size_t(value-1);
}
inline std::vector<float> objNumbers(std::istringstream& row) {
    std::vector<float> result;
    std::string token;
    while(row>>token) {
        std::istringstream number(token); number.imbue(std::locale::classic());
        double value=0; char extra=0;
        if(!(number>>value) || (number>>extra) || !std::isfinite(value)
            || std::abs(value)>std::numeric_limits<float>::max())
            throw ObjParseError("Invalid finite OBJ number: "+token);
        result.push_back(float(value));
    }
    return result;
}
inline std::string objText(const std::string& bytes,bool compatible,std::vector<std::string>& warnings) {
    std::string text=bytes;
    if(bytes.size()>=2 && ((static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[0])==0xff && static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[1])==0xfe)
        || (static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[0])==0xfe && static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[1])==0xff))) {
        if(!compatible) throw ObjParseError("UTF-16 BOM requires the compatible text reader.");
        if(bytes.size()%2) throw ObjParseError("Truncated UTF-16 text.");
        const bool little=static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[0])==0xff;
        auto unit=[&](std::size_t i) {
            const auto a=static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[i]),b=static_cast<unsigned char>(bytes[i+1]);
            return unsigned(little?(a|(b<<8)):((a<<8)|b));
        };
        text.clear();
        for(std::size_t i=2;i<bytes.size();i+=2) {
            unsigned c=unit(i);
            if(c>=0xd800 && c<=0xdbff) {
                if(i+3>=bytes.size()) throw ObjParseError("Truncated UTF-16 surrogate pair.");
                const auto low=unit(i+2);
                if(low<0xdc00 || low>0xdfff) throw ObjParseError("Invalid UTF-16 surrogate pair.");
                c=0x10000+((c-0xd800)<<10)+(low-0xdc00); i+=2;
            } else if(c>=0xdc00 && c<=0xdfff) throw ObjParseError("Unpaired UTF-16 surrogate.");
            if(c<0x80) text+=char(c);
            else if(c<0x800) { text+=char(0xc0|(c>>6)); text+=char(0x80|(c&63)); }
            else if(c<0x10000) { text+=char(0xe0|(c>>12)); text+=char(0x80|((c>>6)&63)); text+=char(0x80|(c&63)); }
            else { text+=char(0xf0|(c>>18)); text+=char(0x80|((c>>12)&63)); text+=char(0x80|((c>>6)&63)); text+=char(0x80|(c&63)); }
        }
        objWarning(warnings,"Decoded UTF-16 BOM text as UTF-8.");
    }
    if(text.compare(0,3,"\xEF\xBB\xBF")==0) text.erase(0,3);
    if(text.find('\0')!=std::string::npos) throw ObjParseError("NUL byte in OBJ text; unsupported encoding or binary file.");
    std::string lines;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<text.size();++i) {
        if(text[i]=='\r') { lines+='\n'; if(i+1<text.size() && text[i+1]=='\n') ++i; }
        else lines+=text[i];
    }
    return lines;
}
inline Model parseObj(const std::string& bytes,const std::string& name,const LoadOptions& options,
                      bool compatible,std::vector<std::string>& warnings) {
    std::istringstream input(objText(bytes,compatible,warnings));
    std::vector<glm::vec3> positions,normals;
    std::vector<glm::vec2> uvs;
    std::vector<GlColor> colors;
    std::vector<ObjFace> faces;
    bool hasColors=false;
    std::string physical,line,group="face";
    std::size_t lineNumber=0,start=0,batch=0;
    while(std::getline(input,physical)) {
        ++lineNumber;
        if(line.empty()) start=lineNumber;
        physical=physical.substr(0,physical.find('#'));
        const auto end=physical.find_last_not_of(" \t");
        const bool continued=end!=std::string::npos && physical[end]=='\\';
        line+=continued?physical.substr(0,end):physical;
        if(continued) { line+=' '; continue; }
        std::istringstream row(line); row.imbue(std::locale::classic());
        std::string kind; row>>kind;
        try {
            if(kind=="v") {
                const auto values=objNumbers(row);
                if(values.size()!=3 && values.size()!=4 && values.size()!=6)
                    throw ObjParseError("Expected v x y z [w] or v x y z r g b.");
                glm::vec3 p(values[0],values[1],values[2]);
                if(values.size()==4) {
                    if(values[3]==0) throw ObjParseError("Homogeneous vertex has zero w.");
                    p/=values[3];
                }
                if(!finiteVector(p)) throw ObjParseError("Vertex overflows after division by w.");
                positions.push_back(p);
                colors.push_back(values.size()==6?GlColor{values[3],values[4],values[5]}:GlColor{});
                hasColors=hasColors || values.size()==6;
            } else if(kind=="vt") {
                const auto values=objNumbers(row);
                if(values.empty() || values.size()>3 || (values.size()==3 && values[2]!=0))
                    throw ObjParseError("Expected vt u [v [0]]; volume texture coordinates are unsupported.");
                uvs.push_back({values[0],values.size()>1?values[1]:0});
            } else if(kind=="vn") {
                const auto values=objNumbers(row);
                if(values.size()!=3) throw ObjParseError("Expected vn x y z.");
                const glm::dvec3 normal(values[0],values[1],values[2]);
                if(glm::length(normal)==0) throw ObjParseError("Zero OBJ normal.");
                normals.push_back(glm::vec3(glm::normalize(normal)));
            } else if(kind=="f") {
                ObjFace face; face.positions=positions.size(); face.uvs=uvs.size(); face.normals=normals.size();
                face.line=start; face.batch=batch; face.name=group;
                std::string token;
                while(row>>token) face.corners.push_back(objCorner(token));
                if(face.corners.size()<3) throw ObjParseError("Face has fewer than three corners.");
                faces.push_back(std::move(face));
            } else if(kind=="o" || kind=="g") {
                std::getline(row,group); const auto first=group.find_first_not_of(" \t");
                group=first==std::string::npos?"face":group.substr(first); ++batch;
            } else if(kind=="mtllib" || kind=="usemtl") {
                ++batch;
                objWarning(warnings,"MTL materials are not loaded; set LoadOptions.texturePath or a Scene material explicitly.");
            } else if(kind=="s") {
                ++batch;
                std::string smoothing; row>>smoothing;
                if(smoothing!="off" && smoothing!="0")
                    objWarning(warnings,"Smoothing groups are not interpolated; supplied vn values are preserved and missing normals are generated per face.");
            } else if(!kind.empty()) throw ObjParseError("Unsupported OBJ record: "+kind);
        } catch(const ObjParseError& e) { throw ObjParseError("line "+std::to_string(start)+": "+e.what()); }
        line.clear();
    }
    if(!line.empty()) throw ObjParseError("line "+std::to_string(start)+": unterminated line continuation.");
    Model model; model.shape=GLShape::Custom; model.name=name;
    Model segment; std::size_t activeBatch=0;
    auto flush=[&] {
        if(options.mergeCoplanarFaces && !hasColors) mergeCoplanar(segment);
        for(auto& face:segment.faces) model.faces.push_back(std::move(face));
        segment.faces.clear();
    };
    for(auto& face:faces) {
        try {
            if(face.batch!=activeBatch) { flush(); activeBatch=face.batch; }
            if(compatible) {
                const auto old=face.corners.size();
                face.corners.erase(std::unique(face.corners.begin(),face.corners.end()),face.corners.end());
                if(face.corners.size()>1 && face.corners.front()==face.corners.back()) face.corners.pop_back();
                if(face.corners.size()!=old) objWarning(warnings,"Removed repeated identical OBJ corners at line "+std::to_string(face.line)+".");
            }
            Mesh mesh; mesh.name=face.name+"_"+std::to_string(face.line);
            std::size_t uvCount=0;
            bool forward=false;
            for(const auto& corner:face.corners) {
                const auto p=objResolve(corner.position,face.positions,positions.size(),compatible);
                mesh.localVertices.push_back(positions[p]);
                if(hasColors) mesh.vertexColors.push_back(colors[p]);
                forward=forward || (corner.position>0 && static_cast<unsigned long long>(corner.position)>face.positions);
                glm::vec2 uv(0);
                if(corner.uv) {
                    uv=uvs[objResolve(corner.uv,face.uvs,uvs.size(),compatible)]; ++uvCount;
                    forward=forward || (corner.uv>0 && static_cast<unsigned long long>(corner.uv)>face.uvs);
                }
                mesh.texcoords.push_back(uv);
            }
            // Normalize only the triangulation workspace; retain original coordinates.
            if(mesh.localVertices.size()<3) throw ObjParseError("Face has fewer than three distinct corners.");
            glm::dvec3 low(mesh.localVertices[0]),high(low);
            for(const auto& p:mesh.localVertices) { low=glm::min(low,glm::dvec3(p)); high=glm::max(high,glm::dvec3(p)); }
            const auto size=high-low; const double scale=std::max({size.x,size.y,size.z});
            if(scale==0) throw ObjParseError("Degenerate polygon.");
            Mesh workspace;
            for(const auto& p:mesh.localVertices) workspace.localVertices.push_back(glm::vec3((glm::dvec3(p)-low)/scale));
            if(workspace.localVertices.size()>3) {
                glm::dvec3 plane(0);
                const auto count=workspace.localVertices.size();
                for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i) {
                    const auto a=glm::dvec3(workspace.localVertices[i]);
                    const auto b=glm::dvec3(workspace.localVertices[(i+1)%count]);
                    plane+=glm::cross(a,b);
                }
                if(glm::length(plane)<1e-12) throw ObjParseError("Degenerate polygon plane.");
                plane=glm::normalize(plane);
                const auto absolute=glm::abs(plane);
                const int axis=absolute.x>absolute.y?(absolute.x>absolute.z?0:2):(absolute.y>absolute.z?1:2);
                std::vector<glm::dvec2> projected;
                for(const auto& p:workspace.localVertices) {
                    if(std::abs(glm::dot(plane,glm::dvec3(p-workspace.localVertices[0])))>1e-5)
                        throw ObjParseError("Non-planar OBJ polygon; export triangulated faces.");
                    projected.push_back(axis==0?glm::dvec2(p.y,p.z):axis==1?glm::dvec2(p.x,p.z):glm::dvec2(p.x,p.y));
                }
                auto cross=[](glm::dvec2 a,glm::dvec2 b,glm::dvec2 c) {
                    return (b.x-a.x)*(c.y-a.y)-(b.y-a.y)*(c.x-a.x);
                };
                auto on=[](glm::dvec2 a,glm::dvec2 b,glm::dvec2 p) {
                    return p.x>=std::min(a.x,b.x)-1e-14 && p.x<=std::max(a.x,b.x)+1e-14
                        && p.y>=std::min(a.y,b.y)-1e-14 && p.y<=std::max(a.y,b.y)+1e-14;
                };
                for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i) for(std::size_t j=i+1;j<count;++j) {
                    if((i+1)%count==j || (j+1)%count==i) continue;
                    const auto a=projected[i],b=projected[(i+1)%count],c=projected[j],d=projected[(j+1)%count];
                    const auto abC=cross(a,b,c),abD=cross(a,b,d),cdA=cross(c,d,a),cdB=cross(c,d,b);
                    const bool crossing=((abC>1e-14 && abD< -1e-14)||(abC< -1e-14 && abD>1e-14))
                        && ((cdA>1e-14 && cdB< -1e-14)||(cdA< -1e-14 && cdB>1e-14));
                    if(crossing || (std::abs(abC)<=1e-14 && on(a,b,c)) || (std::abs(abD)<=1e-14 && on(a,b,d))
                        || (std::abs(cdA)<=1e-14 && on(c,d,a)) || (std::abs(cdB)<=1e-14 && on(c,d,b)))
                        throw ObjParseError("Self-intersection or repeated corner in OBJ polygon.");
                }
            }
            try { mesh.triangleIndices=triangulate(workspace.localVertices); }
            catch(const std::runtime_error& e) { throw ObjParseError(e.what()); }
            workspace.triangleIndices=mesh.triangleIndices;
            recalculateNormals(workspace);
            mesh.vertexNormals=std::move(workspace.vertexNormals);
            for(std::size_t i=0;i<face.corners.size();++i) if(face.corners[i].normal) {
                const auto value=face.corners[i].normal;
                mesh.vertexNormals[i]=normals[objResolve(value,face.normals,normals.size(),compatible)];
                forward=forward || (value>0 && static_cast<unsigned long long>(value)>face.normals);
            }
            if(forward) objWarning(warnings,"Resolved positive forward references at line "+std::to_string(face.line)+".");
            if(uvCount==0) mesh.texcoords.clear();
            else if(uvCount!=face.corners.size()) objWarning(warnings,"Filled missing UV corners with (0,0) at line "+std::to_string(face.line)+".");
            const auto& indices=mesh.triangleIndices;
            mesh.normal=glm::normalize(glm::cross(workspace.localVertices[indices[1]]-workspace.localVertices[indices[0]],
                                                  workspace.localVertices[indices[2]]-workspace.localVertices[indices[0]]));
            if(!validMesh(mesh)) throw ObjParseError("Invalid or degenerate OBJ mesh.");
            segment.faces.push_back(std::move(mesh));
        } catch(const ObjParseError& e) { throw ObjParseError("line "+std::to_string(face.line)+": "+e.what()); }
    }
    flush();
    if(options.mergeCoplanarFaces && hasColors) objWarning(warnings,"Coplanar merging is skipped to preserve vertex colors.");
    if(model.faces.empty()) throw ObjParseError("OBJ contains no polygon faces.");
    return model;
}
} // namespace graphics::detail

namespace graphics {
inline ModelResult AssetLoader::loadObj(const std::filesystem::path& relative,const LoadOptions& options) const {
    ModelResult result;
    const auto utf8=relative.u8string();
    const std::string name(utf8.begin(),utf8.end());
    try {
        if(!options.texturePath.empty() && !features_.textures)
            throw std::runtime_error("Enable texture mode before specifying texturePath.");
        std::ifstream input(resolve(relative),std::ios::binary);
        if(!input) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open OBJ text.");
        const std::string bytes((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(input)),std::istreambuf_iterator<char>());
        if(input.bad()) throw std::runtime_error("OBJ file read failed.");
        Model model;
        try { model=detail::parseObj(bytes,name,options,false,result.warnings); }
        catch(const detail::ObjParseError& first) {
            if(!options.allowObjFallback) throw;
            result.warnings.clear();
            try { model=detail::parseObj(bytes,name,options,true,result.warnings); }
            catch(const detail::ObjParseError& second) {
                throw std::runtime_error(std::string("Standard reader: ")+first.what()+"; compatible reader: "+second.what());
            }
            result.usedFallback=true;
            detail::objWarning(result.warnings,std::string("Compatible OBJ reader used after: ")+first.what());
        }
        if(!options.texturePath.empty()) {
            auto image=texture(options.texturePath,options.flipTextureRows);
            for(auto& mesh:model.faces) {
                if(mesh.texcoords.empty()) throw std::runtime_error("Explicit texture requires UV coordinates on every face.");
                mesh.material.texture=image; mesh.material.useTexture=true;
            }
        }
        auto finished=detail::finishLoad(std::move(model),options);
        finished.warnings=std::move(result.warnings); finished.usedFallback=result.usedFallback;
        return finished;
    } catch(const std::exception& e) { result.error=name+": "+e.what(); return result; }
}
} // namespace graphics
```

## framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl

기존 호출을 OBJ API로 연결하고 표기별 파싱·명시적인 재시도·오류·경고 반환을 구현한다.

적용 경로:

- `framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_15/framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_16/framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_17/framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_18/framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_19/framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl`
- `openGL_3dAssign_20/framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl`
- `standard/framework/detail/PrimitiveLoader.inl`

### before

```text
#pragma once
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <locale>
namespace graphics {
namespace detail {
inline std::size_t objIndex(const std::string& text,std::size_t count) {
    std::size_t consumed=0;
    const auto index=std::stoll(text,&consumed);
    if(consumed!=text.size() || index==0) throw std::runtime_error("Invalid OBJ index.");
    const auto resolved=index>0?index-1:static_cast<long long>(count)+index;
    if(resolved<0 || static_cast<unsigned long long>(resolved)>=count)
        throw std::runtime_error("OBJ index is out of range.");
    return std::size_t(resolved);
}
}
inline ModelResult AssetLoader::loadPrimitive(const std::filesystem::path& relative,const LoadOptions& options) const {
        try {
            if(!options.texturePath.empty()&&!features_.textures)
                throw std::runtime_error("Enable texture mode before specifying texturePath.");
            std::ifstream input(resolve(relative),std::ios::binary);
            if(!input) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open primitive data.");
            input.imbue(std::locale::classic());
            std::vector<glm::vec3> positions,normals;
            std::vector<glm::vec2> uvs;
            Model model; model.shape=GLShape::Custom; model.name=relative.u8string();
            std::string line; std::size_t lineNumber=0;
            while(std::getline(input,line)) {
                ++lineNumber;
                if(lineNumber==1 && line.compare(0,3,"\xEF\xBB\xBF")==0) line.erase(0,3);
                line=line.substr(0,line.find('#'));
                std::istringstream row(line); row.imbue(std::locale::classic());
                std::string kind; row>>kind;
                if(kind=="v"||kind=="vn") {
                    glm::vec3 v; if(!(row>>v.x>>v.y>>v.z)||!detail::finiteVector(v))
                        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid vector at line "+std::to_string(lineNumber));
                    (kind=="v"?positions:normals).push_back(v);
                } else if(kind=="vt") {
                    glm::vec2 uv; if(!(row>>uv.x>>uv.y)||!std::isfinite(uv.x)||!std::isfinite(uv.y))
                        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid UV at line "+std::to_string(lineNumber));
                    uvs.push_back(uv);
                } else if(kind=="f") {
                    Mesh mesh; mesh.name="face_"+std::to_string(model.faces.size());
                    std::string corner; bool hasUV=false,hasNormal=false; std::size_t uvCount=0,normalCount=0;
                    while(row>>corner) {
                        const auto first=corner.find('/');
                        const auto second=first==std::string::npos?first:corner.find('/',first+1);
                        mesh.localVertices.push_back(positions.at(detail::objIndex(corner.substr(0,first),positions.size())));
                        glm::vec2 uv(0); glm::vec3 normal(0);
                        if(first!=std::string::npos) {
                            const auto part=corner.substr(first+1,second==std::string::npos?second:second-first-1);
                            if(!part.empty()) {uv=uvs.at(detail::objIndex(part,uvs.size()));hasUV=true;++uvCount;}
                        }
                        if(second!=std::string::npos) {
                            normal=normals.at(detail::objIndex(corner.substr(second+1),normals.size()));hasNormal=true;++normalCount;
                        }
                        mesh.texcoords.push_back(uv);mesh.vertexNormals.push_back(normal);
                    }
                    if((hasUV&&uvCount!=mesh.localVertices.size())||(hasNormal&&normalCount!=mesh.localVertices.size()))
                        throw std::runtime_error("Mixed OBJ corner attributes in one face.");
                    mesh.triangleIndices=detail::triangulate(mesh.localVertices);
                    if(!hasNormal) recalculateNormals(mesh);
                    if(!hasUV || !features_.textures) mesh.texcoords.clear();
                    const auto& indices=mesh.triangleIndices;
                    mesh.normal=glm::normalize(glm::cross(mesh.localVertices[indices[1]]-mesh.localVertices[indices[0]],
                                                          mesh.localVertices[indices[2]]-mesh.localVertices[indices[0]]));
                    model.faces.push_back(std::move(mesh));
                } else if(!kind.empty()&&kind!="g"&&kind!="o"&&kind!="s"&&kind!="mtllib"&&kind!="usemtl")
                    throw std::runtime_error("Unsupported primitive record at line "+std::to_string(lineNumber));
            }
            if(input.bad()) throw std::runtime_error("Primitive file read failed.");
            if(options.mergeCoplanarFaces) detail::mergeCoplanar(model);
            if(!options.texturePath.empty()) {
                auto image=texture(options.texturePath,options.flipTextureRows);
                for(auto& mesh:model.faces) {mesh.material.texture=image;mesh.material.useTexture=true;}
            }
            return detail::finishLoad(std::move(model),options);
        } catch(const std::exception& e) {ModelResult result;result.error=e.what();return result;}
    }

} // namespace graphics
```
